grip.note: the grip's centre is the model origin (the fist box covers y -2..+2); the model is y up with its big faces across z, and the converter turns it by a half turn about x into the weapon frame

note: The Sunweaver's staff, tier I (plain), hand-authored at 1 texel a px: a warm ash shaft with a grain line on an iron foot and spike, a leather grip between gilt rings, and a small gilt sun 3 px across on four cream rays; the sun's heart is one 1 px cube, lit on its north and south faces (2 glow texels); 32 px long.
